serving_contract.required_serving: Serve original/original.html and split/index.html from their own capsule directories, each with its sibling assets/ directory. Nothing else is needed: there is no external CSS, JS, font, media, XHR, fetch or sessionStorage dependency.
serving_contract.portal_iframe_note: The portal iframe body is not available at the repository path for either surface, because the four destination corpora are intentionally not vendored. This is identical to the accepted S2 capture, where the four targets were deliberately left unhydrated and the only 404s in the netlog were the four portal targets plus the harness favicon request. It is a recorded serving fact, not a source defect, and it is not a parity claim.
serving_contract.contrast_with_cdx014: CDX014 (also a Codex capsule) is CONTEXT_AWARE_ONLY because its 178 runtime media files live in a sibling folder whose live Drive name was renamed after authoring, so its repository path is NOT a runtime surface and the shared harnesses record an explicit SKIP. CDX017 is the opposite case: its four runtime assets are source-owned and live inside its own folder, so the repository path IS a runtime surface and no SKIP disposition is needed. The two capsules must not be conflated.

nondeterminism_contract.s4_comparison_contract: ORIGINAL vs SPLIT via source-specific structural / DOM-state / geometry parity plus a CENTRAL-approved bounded visual method. No SSIM, perceptual or pixel threshold is proposed, recorded or implied by this capsule.
nondeterminism_contract.empirical_basis: Three captures of the same logical ready state produced three different PNG digests in the accepted S2 run (1fee1d7d3a6e3935, 41d0d3e36be1324d, 15215d29bb48b90f), and the pointer-water pair differed again after a 520ms wait (ac4386ceb5635b38 vs aa55acfadf9696a0).
